title: What You Envy Knows You
subtitle: the sting as informant
mapEpigraph: Envy is an honest messenger with terrible manners.

prompts.text: Whose news carries a particular sting?
What exact quality, permission, freedom, or form of visibility does it make visible?
What my envy may be pointing toward is…

blocks.title: Without their name
blocks.instruction: Write the person's name. Beneath it, name the exact quality or permission their life makes visible. Then rewrite the sentence without their name.
